says: A window toolbar's glyphs (ctl.tool in Ordaen/art.luna), drawn on Ordaen's ToolButton, ToolPick and ToolAct: rows of 16 x 16 px (32 x 32 texels), each a white glyph with its black shadow 1 px under it, for the box's tint to colour: the filter (a funnel), the sort (three lines shortening), then the views: columns, categories, list, table; refresh (a circling arrow), whom (a figure: for whom a list is); the one-bag view (a square in a square), arrange (two arrows, up and down: «Sort the bags»); six rows clear.
origin: Drawn by the design's Dropdown (its `GLYPHS`): wow-dev-tools `design/scripts/tool-glyphs.mjs` writes a page of them; the page shot at 2x on black and on white with `design/scripts/shot.mjs --width 16 --height 256 --scale 2` (`?bg=black`, `bg=white`), then matted.
